scripts.lint: pnpm --dir apps/web run lint && uv run --locked ruff check
scripts.format:check: pnpm --dir apps/web run format:check && uv run --locked ruff format --check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir apps/web run typecheck && uv run --locked mypy
scripts.test: pnpm --dir apps/web run test && uv run --locked pytest
